Benjamin Franklin propose de prouver que: Benjamin Franklin proposed to prove that lightning is electrical, with a metal rod, then a kite and a key. Franklin mentions the kite in a 1752 letter, but the detailed account comes from Joseph Priestley, fifteen years later. In France, Thomas-François Dalibard carried out the rod experiment in May 1752. Franklin had imagined the lightning rod as early as 1749.
En 1753, Georg Richmann a voulu refaire: In 1753, Georg Richmann tried to repeat the experiment. Lightning killed him. The AI advises you to stick to quizzes.
Alessandro Volta empile des disques de c: Alessandro Volta stacked discs of copper and zinc separated by cardboard soaked in salt water: the first electric battery provided a steady current. He opposed Luigi Galvani, who believed in an “animal electricity” in frogs' legs: for Volta, the current came from the two metals. Napoleon made him a count in 1810, and the volt is named after him.
Des grenouilles, une querelle et une pil: Frogs, a quarrel and a battery. Science often advances to prove a colleague wrong. The AI approves.
La pile de Volta empile du zinc et du cu: Volta's pile stacks zinc and copper. Davy used it in 1807 to isolate sodium and potassium. An atom escapes from the electrolysis.
Michael Faraday, fils de forgeron, appre: Michael Faraday, a blacksmith's son and a bookbinder's apprentice at 14, discovered induction: a magnet moving near a coil creates a current in it. It is the principle of the generators that produce almost all our electricity. He had no command of mathematics: Maxwell would put his ideas into equations. The anecdote about the minister to whom he supposedly replied that one day electricity could be taxed is probably invented.
Faraday n'avait pas fait d'études et a c: Faraday had no schooling and changed the world. The AI leaves you to ponder your excuses.
James Clerk Maxwell réunit électricité e: James Clerk Maxwell united electricity and magnetism in a few equations and showed that electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of light: light is one of them. Heinrich Hertz would produce these waves twenty years later, paving the way for radio. In 1861, Maxwell also had the first color photograph projected, of a tartan ribbon.
Maxwell a unifié la lumière, l'électrici: Maxwell unified light, electricity and magnetism. The AI unifies your mistakes in a single report.
